overview_description.description: Superorder.io is a crypto trading platform which integrates with popular crypto exchanges and gives superpowers to its users. Apart from convenient trading interface, Superorder allows traders to build strategies and predefine order flows, utilizing features which are not available on exchanges directly thus helping traders to earn more.
